span: one common half-open integer frame domain [0, frame_count)
response_contract: externally supplied unique ordered response centers and paired finite logits; not acoustic-event labels
clock_contract: complete supplied clock family rendered over the whole domain; no truth-derived clock discovery
assignment: chronological, one response per tick and one tick per response
inventory_objective: maximum matched responses, then minimum total absolute frame offset; not a musical model score
tie_accounting: count every distinct optimal matching once and report exact pair/tick/response occurrence counts
witness_tie: match before skipping a tick, then nearest response, then earlier response; one diagnostic witness only
